images.caption: Figure 1:Problem Illustration.I)Knowledge accessretrieves task-relevant evidence from the source, but does not necessarily accumulate reusable source understanding across tasks, requiring the model to repeatedly reconstruct how evidence should be interpreted or combined.II)Our goal issource learning: progressively developing reusable source understanding through continued study and use, while retaining direct access to the authoritative source.

Figure 2:Overview ofSourceLearn.Initial Constructionbuilds a provisional source modelM0M_{0}from the authoritative sourceDD.Self-Directed Source Learningdeepens and connects source understanding through adaptive study, producingMSM_{S}.Task-Guided Source Learninguses guidance-task failures and recurring representation needs to further refine the model intoMTM_{T}.
At inference time,Source-Model Activationcombines relevant source-model context with directly retrieved evidence for downstream tasks.

Figure 3:Ablation ofSourceLearnwith GPT-5.6-Luna: the source learning stages (left) and the two pathways of Task-Guided Source Learning (right). Each bar reports answer accuracy (%) on two sources of a QA benchmark.

Figure 4:Source learning beyond compression.FromM0M_{0}toMSM_{S}toMTM_{T}, source learning (a) changes what the model represents, (b) makes conditions more explicit, (c) increases coverage of source knowledge required by future tasks, and (d) higher coverage is associated with higher answer accuracy.
